CustomField.description: Indicates this product line / BU is the primary one for the opportunity. Drives routing, Opp Team population, and reporting. Only one record per Opportunity can be primary.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to mark this as the primary Business Unit for the deal. Only one product line can be primary per opportunity. The primary BU is used for team assignment, routing, and executive reporting.
CustomField.label: Primary BU
